decision: FIX10 CANDIDATE — EXACT WINDOWS AUTOMATED GATE + >=5 MIN TWO-CLIENT LOCAL MOVEMENT/ITEM STRESS REQUIRED

trigger_evidence.duration_note: approximately 2m20s, shorter than final acceptance but sufficient to reproduce the movement symptom
trigger_evidence.items: user reports items do not disappear
trigger_evidence.diagnosis: FIX9 showed healthy steady frame/server budgets while corrections accumulated during active movement. Existing input entries already carry client_tick, but authority applies an input sequence on a later server wall-clock tick. Tick-keyed reconciliation therefore confuses normal transport phase with spatial divergence and repeatedly feeds the FIX8 visual correction compositor.

architecture.sidecar_scope: only the target peer's local-player post-input kinematic acknowledgement
architecture.fallback: invalid/missing/gapped acknowledgement falls back to inherited FIX8 reconciliation

server: preserve the existing client_tick from the input batch through consumption
capture authoritative position/velocity/yaw immediately after first application of a new input sequence
attach the latest per-peer prediction acknowledgement outside full/compact canonical snapshots
client: extract and register prediction acknowledgement sidecars before snapshot reconciliation
preserve FIX9 phase accounting and transport behavior
reconciler: maintain an independent bounded 512-tick local prediction timeline
rebase at the authoritative post-input state for the acknowledged client tick
replay every contiguous local tick after that client tick to the current client prediction tick
compute correction from reconstructed current state rather than server wall-clock phase
treat repeated identical acknowledgement as ACK_REPLAY without moving prediction
preserve FIX8 bounded visual correction for real divergence
source_contract_compatibility: current FIX10 server leaf retains accepted FIX6/FIX7 source-order and hot-path anchors while behavior remains inherited through m3_dedicated_server_runtime_fix7.gd
current FIX10 client leaf retains accepted FIX6 telemetry and FIX9 frame-budget source probes while behavior remains inherited through m3_graphical_client_runtime_fix9.gd
current FIX10 reconciler retains accepted FIX8 source-policy probes while behavior remains inherited through client_prediction_reconciler_fix8.gd

manual_acceptance.actions: both clients continuously move, turn, start/stop and sprint while repeatedly exercising pickup/drop/transfer/inventory flows
manual_acceptance.subjective: the frequent spring/back-pull micro-rollbacks must be absent or substantially reduced compared with the FIX9 debug run

known_separate_issue: Long FIX9 debug logs also showed intermittent MULTIPLAYER_SAME_REVISION_MUTATION. Items remained present and this is treated as a separate replica transport race unless it blocks FIX10 validation.
status: Implementation candidate and compatibility bridges are committed and draft PR #32 is open. Exact Windows editor import, focused/regression gate, two-client process test and long manual stress remain required before acceptance.
